constraints: The character must take risks without consulting others.
The character must use humor to deflect tension or discomfort.
The character must express self-doubt when confronted or corrected.
The character must apologize when proven wrong, often with sarcasm or resignation.
The character must reference personal unemployment or lack of financial contribution in arguments.
The character must use exaggerated or absurd questions to test emotional boundaries.
